metadata.title: Xhuma Operational Diagnostics Query Pack Snapshot
metadata.description: Sanitised snapshot of the 20 standard KQL diagnostic queries in the xhuma-operational-diagnostics Query Pack. This file serves as a documentation and reference snapshot; it is not yet the active Terraform source of truth.

queries.description: Aggregates execution latency and invocation counts across primary request pipeline stages (pds.lookup, sds.trace, sds.endpoint, gpconnect.http, fhir.decode, fhir.models, fhir.index, ccda.convert, ccda.serialize, audit.persist), providing a high-level latency breakdown.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name startswith "xhuma."
| extend stage = tostring(split(name, ".")[1])
| summarize
    CallCount = count(),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    P50Ms = round(percentile(duration, 50), 2),
    P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2),
    MaxDurationMs = round(max(duration), 2)
  by name, success
| order by CallCount desc

queries.description: Counts recent ITI endpoint activity across /SOAP/iti55, /SOAP/iti38, and /SOAP/iti39. Counts recent ITI endpoint activity; does not currently return message IDs, SOAP action or HTTP status.
queries.body:
requests
| where url contains "/SOAP/iti" or name contains "/SOAP/iti"
| extend endpoint = tostring(split(url, "?")[0])
| summarize
    RequestCount = count(),
    SuccessCount = countif(success == true),
    FailureCount = countif(success == false),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2)
  by endpoint, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Traces individual steps within GP Connect processing (gpconnect.http, fhir.decode, fhir.models, fhir.index, ccda.convert).
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name in ("xhuma.gpconnect.http", "xhuma.fhir.decode", "xhuma.fhir.models", "xhuma.fhir.index", "xhuma.ccda.convert")
| project timestamp, operation_Id, name, duration, success, resultCode, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.displayName: Xhuma | GP Connect | Upstream latency trend
queries.description: Reports p50, p95, and maximum response times of the upstream GP Connect API over time. Reports p50, p95 and maximum timing where implemented; does not report p99.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.gpconnect.http"
| summarize
    p50 = round(percentile(duration, 50), 2),
    p95 = round(percentile(duration, 95), 2),
    max_duration = round(max(duration), 2),
    CallCount = count()
  by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Summarises HTTP status codes returned by upstream GP practice endpoints, distinguishing client errors (4xx) from remote server errors (5xx).
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.gpconnect.http"
| summarize
    CallCount = count(),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2)
  by resultCode, success, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.displayName: Xhuma | GP Connect | End-to-end operation breakdown
queries.description: Sums and compares instrumented stage durations under a shared operation ID. Represents the sum of instrumented pipeline stages, not necessarily complete wall-clock request latency.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name startswith "xhuma."
| summarize
    TotalInstrumentedMs = sum(duration),
    StageCount = count(),
    Stages = make_set(name)
  by operation_Id
| order by TotalInstrumentedMs desc

queries.description: Reports calls, failure count, and latency for Spine Directory Service (SDS) routing queries and Personal Demographics Service (PDS) patient verification calls. Does not project full response-code distributions.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name in ("xhuma.pds.lookup", "xhuma.sds.trace", "xhuma.sds.endpoint", "xhuma.sds.self")
| summarize
    Calls = count(),
    Failures = countif(success == false),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    MaxDurationMs = round(max(duration), 2)
  by name, bin(timestamp, 30m)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Reports structured relay lifecycle events from application and hub logs (connect, disconnect, route registration); does not prove TLS negotiation.
queries.body:
traces
| where message contains "relay" or customDimensions.component == "relay"
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Tracks payload forwarding through the internal proxy/relay to upstream endpoints, reporting relay transport status (transport=relay).
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.gpconnect.http" and customDimensions.transport == "relay"
| project timestamp, operation_Id, duration, success, resultCode, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Measures Redis cache hit ratio for dm+d concept lookups (cache=terminology and cache=terminology.resolved) during medication conversion.
queries.body:
customMetrics
| where name == "xhuma.cache.lookups" and (customDimensions.cache startswith "terminology")
| summarize
    Hits = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "hit"),
    Misses = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "miss")
  by tostring(customDimensions.cache), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend Total = Hits + Misses
| extend HitRatePercent = round(100.0 * Hits / Total, 2)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Reports timestamp, operation ID, cache-hit property, duration and custom dimensions for recent resolved dm+d lookups; does not expose drug codes, dose mappings or clinical terminology payloads.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.terminology.resolved.cache.read"
| project timestamp, operation_Id, duration, success, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Identifies requests where local dm+d cache misses forced fallback HTTP queries to the NHS Terminology Server (xhuma.terminology.http).
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.terminology.http"
| project timestamp, operation_Id, duration, success, resultCode, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.displayName: Xhuma | Cache | Document hits and misses
queries.description: Represents ITI-38 document pointer/cache lookup behaviour (cache=document); does not represent ITI-39 document retrieval or regeneration.
queries.body:
customMetrics
| where name == "xhuma.cache.lookups" and customDimensions.cache == "document"
| summarize
    Hits = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "hit"),
    Misses = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "miss")
  by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend Total = Hits + Misses
| extend HitRatePercent = round(100.0 * Hits / Total, 2)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Compares document pointer/read (document.cache.read) and retrieval cache (document.cache.retrieve) instrumentation; does not expose TTL expiry or memory allocation.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name in ("xhuma.document.cache.read", "xhuma.document.cache.retrieve", "xhuma.ccda.cache.write")
| summarize
    Ops = count(),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    Failures = countif(success == false)
  by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.displayName: Xhuma | Cache | All cache hit rates
queries.description: Covers the instrumented document, retrieval, and terminology cache spans included by its KQL; does not cover PDS or SDS cache spans unless specifically instrumented.
queries.body:
customMetrics
| where name == "xhuma.cache.lookups"
| summarize
    Hits = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "hit"),
    Misses = sumif(value, customDimensions.outcome == "miss")
  by tostring(customDimensions.cache), bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend Total = Hits + Misses
| extend HitRatePercent = round(100.0 * Hits / Total, 2)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Reports attempts, failures, and latency for PostgreSQL audit persistence (xhuma.audit.persist); does not directly prove connection-pool exhaustion.
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name == "xhuma.audit.persist"
| summarize
    Attempts = count(),
    Failures = countif(success == false),
    AvgDurationMs = round(avg(duration), 2),
    MaxDurationMs = round(max(duration), 2)
  by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Reports validation, configuration, and rejection traces logged by the mTLS middleware; does not provide a complete record of every TLS handshake.
queries.body:
traces
| where message contains "Epic CA Verification" or message contains "mTLS"
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.description: Surfaces pipeline operations exceeding defined latency thresholds (threshold is 250 ms, not 1500 ms).
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name startswith "xhuma." and duration > 250
| project timestamp, operation_Id, name, duration, success, customDimensions
| order by duration desc

queries.description: Lists pipeline stages that recorded an error or failure outcome (success == false or stage.outcome == "error").
queries.body:
dependencies
| where name startswith "xhuma." and success == false
| project timestamp, operation_Id, name, duration, resultCode, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

queries.displayName: Xhuma | Errors | Application errors and exceptions
queries.description: Reports error traces, unhandled exceptions, and internal server error logs; does not guarantee complete traceback bodies.
queries.body:
union
  (exceptions | project timestamp, operation_Id, problemId, type, outerMessage, severityLevel = 3),
  (traces | where severityLevel >= 3 | project timestamp, operation_Id, problemId = "", type = "TraceError", outerMessage = message, severityLevel)
| order by timestamp desc
